prompt: What does being on call mean in a healthy rota?

choices.text: One named person answers the pages, and everybody else stops watching
Everybody watches the alert channel all the time, taking turns to reply to each page
The most senior engineer answers every page
Whoever is awake answers

choices.text: Two, a primary and a secondary
choices.why: Each would be on call half the time.

choices.text: Three, one per eight-hour shift

Twelve, one per month

prompt: What are the three parts of a handover?

choices.text: Pages, tickets and silences, with the count of each and their owners
choices.why: The silences belong in it, but not as the structure.

choices.text: Who caused each incident, who fixed it, and who reviews it
The dashboards, the runbooks and the passwords

Time to acknowledge
Time to mitigate after the page

prompt: What does a blameless postmortem look for?

The fastest way to close the document

The actions, which are paid for out of the team's error budget

prompt: Put the parts of a postmortem in the order the lesson's example uses.
